text:
maria: Heads-up: we have a tranche of medium+ SAST/DAST findings stuck in triage for 48h. Compliance wants a ship-or-escalate SLA. Proposing: auto-escalate to oncall after 24h, create an evidence bundle in an audit-bucket, and (only if needed) request an ephemeral KMS grant for the scanner to decrypt test payloads. Thoughts?

ashwin: +1 to escalation automation. Can we do a staged escalation: 24h -> PR comment + assignee; 36h -> Slack thread @oncall; 48h -> PagerDuty page? Avoid immediate pages if a human already owns it.

jordan: On ephemeral KMS grants — we need to be careful. Scanner currently uses a long-lived service account key in staging. We should switch to short-lived STS tokens and grant kms:Decrypt for specific key versions. Also audit every grant request with requestor and PR id.

carol: Audit retention ask from compliance was 3y for scan evidence (hashed). Storing full binaries is heavy. Suggest storing metadata + signed evidence blobs (sha256) and a pointer to an encrypted bucket object lifecycle of 3y. Need cost estimate.

sec-bot: [scan-run] nightly-sast/daST finished: 12 new medium, 2 high. Summary: sql-injection-like findings in payment-service, auth redirect in web-proxy. Link: https://internal-scans/reports/5100004321

maria: thanks bot. For the automation flow, I sketched a GH Action that runs on schedule and on PR label. It can: comment + assign, create audit object, then call our escalation webhook. Example snippet:```yaml
name: triage-escalator
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 8 * * *'
jobs:
  escalate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - run: |
          curl -X POST "$SCANNER_API/triage/escalate" -H "Authorization: Bearer ${{ secrets.SCANNER_API_TOKEN }}" -d '{"pr": "${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}", "threshold_hours": 24}'
```

ashwin: Love it. Make sure the GH Action writes a verifiable audit event to the audit service before taking any escalation action (idempotent). Also the action should run as a GitHub App with a minimal permission set, not a user token.

jordan: For the KMS grant API we talked about: prefer an internal agent that exchanges the GitHub App identity for an ephemeral role via our IAM service, performs a conditional grant scoped to the PR and crypto key id, stamps an audit record, and returns a short-lived token to the runner. Example request (internal):```bash
curl -X POST https://iam.internal/rpc/ephemeral-grant \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $GITHUB_APP_JWT" \
  -d '{"key":"projects/redwood/keys/scan-test-key","reason":"triage:5100004321","ttl_seconds":600}'
```

carol: Also add a policy gate: ephemeral grants only allowed when scan evidence bundle is linked and a human reviewer is assigned. Deny for auto-escalation->page path.

oncall-sre: From oncall POV: please do NOT page us for each aging finding. We want a single aggregated alert with a list+severity and a runbook link. If a finding is P0/P1 then page immediately. For everything else, aggregated digest at escalation window. Runbook should include: who to call, how to generate evidence, how to revoke ephemeral grants, and audit-check commands.

maria: agreed. I'll draft the runbook. Also want an easy command to verify audit entries. Example:```bash
# verify audit entry for PR triage
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $ME" https://audit.internal/entries?pr=5100004321 | jq '.[0] | {id,actor,action,timestamp}'
```

devex: Heads-up for SDK teams: if we change scanner auth flow you'll need to rotate any references to the old SA keys in CI templates. We'll prepare migration docs and a migration GH Action that swaps secrets safely.

ashwin: Security note: we must add a read-only attestation record to the PR when evidence is archived (signed by our audit key). That makes rollbacks easier and gives product teams proof-of-triage.

maria: Action items I captured: 1) ashwin + devex: implement GH Action + audit write (ETA Wed) 2) jordan: design ephemeral-grant API + policy checks (ETA Fri) 3) carol: cost estimate + retention config for evidence bucket (ETA Tue) 4) oncall-sre: provide aggregated alert format + runbook template (ETA Mon) 5) sec-bot: add digest message at escalation windows (ETA next release). I'll open a tracking issue and link here.

carol: one more — update compliance with the proposed digest cadence before we flip enforcement on. They prefer 7-day grace for low risk.

maria: noted. I'll include that in the tracking issue. Thanks all :thumbsup:
